page.overview:
What is Aaricetri?

Aaricetri was a planet located on the very edge of the Imperial Outer Rim. The starport city of Penshakka was located on Aaricetri. The Aaricetrian defence fleet consists in Z-95D Headhunters and Z-95D-2 Headhunters.

Due to its relatively isolated location, the planet has only in the last few decades prior to the Battle of Yavin seen rapid industrialization.

The Empire has sent several offers to make the planet join them, but the Aaricetrians cared for their independence, and declined Empire's offers. They also refused to acknowledge the Alliance's government.

During Rekk Kashiin's kidnapping, the ISB violated Aaricetri's space to intercept the rebel ship. As a consequence, the relations between the Empire and Aaricetri cooled, whereas the relations with the Rebel Alliance warmed. A rebel embassy was later established on the planet.
